status.description: answers_needed: the tapper, or the sender of an older request being accepted, must finish their name and answers; no new half is kept and an existing request stays. waiting: the owner has a connection request, which waits until they answer it. connected: the half accepted the owner's request. already_connected: the two were connected before. same_kind: connecting across token kinds, both have a kind and the kinds are equal, so no request is sent. no_kind: connecting across token kinds, either person has no kind, so no request is sent. same_group: connecting across groups, the two are in the same group, so nothing is kept. no_group: connecting across groups, and either isn't in a group, so nothing is kept

owner_name.description: The owner's current name, which the token page shows so that people notice swapped tokens, or null when they have no name of their own or this Event Service has never seen them

owner_bio.description: The owner's current bio, which the token page shows under their name, or null when they have none or this Event Service has never seen them

owner_avatar.description: The owner's current avatar look, or null when none is available

character.description: Which character, such as suit or dress

skin.description: The skin tone, such as warm

hair.description: The hair colour, such as auburn

suit.description: The colour of the suit or dress, such as emerald
